title: Verify: Scene content and manifest contain no svg and resolve to PNG ids
summary: Unit tests over real content and manifest via runtime/content
description: Spec-driven assertions on bedroom content and manifest. Content is parsed from the bundled yaml, no I/O mocks needed beyond that.
acceptance_criteria: No .svg in manifest or scene JSON

steps.symbol: new: describe('scene content uses only PNGs')
steps.action: Import { scene, sceneSpec, manifest } from '../src/runtime/content', planPreload from '@game/engine/planPreload', resolveCharacterAnimation from '@game/engine/characterAnimation', generateAssets and ART_SOURCES. Tests: (1) JSON.stringify(manifest) and JSON.stringify(sceneSpec) do not contain '.svg'; (2) every non-audio manifest path ends '.png'; (3) planPreload(scene, manifest).unknown equals []; (4) each object position + its manifest dimensions is within x<=480 and y<=270; (5) for idle, walk, interact resolveCharacterAnimation(sceneSpec.characters[0], name, manifest) returns asset 'character:boy-sheet' and manifest animations frames lengths 4, 6, 4; (6) the dust effect area width 480 and height 270; (7) manifest image dimensions equal generateAssets(ART_SOURCES) entries.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/sceneContentPng.test.ts

steps.action: Run it and update only assertions that name old asset ids or 320x180 positions (objects/bed and similar) to the new room/* ids and positions from bedroom.yaml.
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/content.test.ts tests/sceneView.test.ts
